notes.title: OUT NOW! The game from one of our teams! Go show some love!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=skfLkHA1kpc;full][/previewyoutube]

Our friends at Bober Bros have released their game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3037930/Bober_Bros_The_Hole]The Hole[/url], and it’s available now!

This unsettling and deeply atmospheric exploration of domestic abuse is a must-play. We’re excited to recommend it because its heavy atmosphere and thought-provoking social themes resonate strongly with all of us.

Here’s what stood out to us:
— Unlimited in-game beer? Yes, please!
— No cheap jump scares—just a powerful story and haunting imagery.
— A tension-building approach rooted in real-life experiences.
— Meticulous attention to detail, including a delightful Easter egg featuring a character from No I’m Not Human!

Support these talented developers! Go check their game out! 🕳

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3037930/Bober_Bros_The_Hole

notes.title: The game from the developers of Violent Horror Stories is releasing 12.05.2024
notes.notes:
We want to shine a light on an upcoming indie horror game from  [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/SUPERBOBERBROS]Bober Bros[/url]!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3037930/Bober_Bros_The_Hole/][b]The Hole[/b][/url] is a raw, deeply personal exploration of family abuse and human horror — more intimate and visceral than our own. It doesn’t rely on cheap scares but instead captures the suffocating tension of a broken home, a chilling narrative grounded in real-life experiences.

Their work left a lasting impression on us. it’s honest, unsettling, and unforgettable. If you’ve been drawn into the atmosphere and social themes of our own game, you’ll find even darker truths in The Hole.

And keep an eye out — you might spot a familiar character in their world. 😉

Support this courageous storytelling by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3037930/Bober_Bros_The_Hole/]wishlisting The Hole[/url] today.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3037930/Bober_Bros_The_Hole/][b]THE HOLE IS RELEASING 12.05.2024!!![/b][/url]

Let’s show Bober Bros the love they deserve!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3037930/Bober_Bros_The_Hole

notes.title: No, I'm not a Human ARG!
Halloween discount and update
notes.notes:
Friends, gamers, countrymen!
All Along the Toon Tower team has released a little Halloween-themed update! Just to (pumpkin-) spice things up a little, and as a thank you for all the amazing support this little indie project of ours has been getting.

In addition to that we are happy to offer a discount in honour of the spookiest holiday of the year!

Don't forget to: eat plenty of vitamins B12, A, and iron (which can all be found in liver); avoid walking alone at night in ghost-ridden parts of Tokyo; whistle a merry tune once and again; and be mindful about who you let into your house!

Happy holidays from the Violent Horror Stories Anthology teams!

notes.title: Thank you for your support!
notes.notes:
You have given us a very big gift. We are attaching a picture with the art that YOU created! 

Thank you very much for your attention to our game. It greatly motivates us to create not only good games but also heartfelt games about experiences that you all are surely familiar with. Your support warms our hearts. 

Once again, thank you, and we will do our best to delight you at the release!

You can check news about our games on Discord: https://discord.gg/g25gaKZjVm
